name: solidworks-automation
description: Automate a local Windows SolidWorks session through CAD workflows and a bundled stdio MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Use Python COM automation and a local stdio MCP server for SolidWorks parts, assemblies, mates, drawings, exports, appearances, reviews, threaded holes, CNC features, and Motion Studies.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the active SolidWorks document and environment.
Create this parametric part and verify its features.
Review this assembly and report mate or geometry issues.
